intent: A tooltip: a small dark floating label (with an optional hotkey) shown on hover/focus of its trigger. Always dark so it reads above any surface.
dont_use_when: Essential information that must not be hover-only.
Rich or interactive content — use a popover.

tokens.note: Deliberately dark so it floats above any surface — the background/arrow (--color-bg-overlay) and divider (--color-border-overlay) are theme-independent overlay tokens, so it is fully token-bound.

a11y.wiring: Radix associates the tooltip with its trigger; the tooltip itself is not focusable.
a11y.nonEssential: hover/focus only — never the sole home of essential information.
